request.purpose: Scientific research on medication use and treatment gaps in routine care.
request.question: Among patients with atrial fibrillation, what share takes phenprocoumon, per region?
definitions: Atrial fibrillation = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I48.
Phenprocoumon = ATC code starting with B01AA.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report per region: patients with atrial fibrillation and % with active phenprocoumon, one decimal.
